command: kubectl get pods -n wiki-f054 -o yaml | grep -A 5 "configMap" | head -50
kubectl get all -n wiki-f054 -o yaml | grep -i "configmap" | head -50
kubectl get deployments,statefulsets,daemonsets,jobs,cronjobs -n wiki-f054 -o yaml | grep -E "name:|configMap.*name:" | grep -A1 "configMap"
kubectl get deployments,statefulsets,daemonsets,jobs,cronjobs -n wiki-f054 -o json | jq '.items[].spec.template.spec.volumes[]? | select(.configMap) | .configMap.name' 2>/dev/null | sort -u
